subject: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood + Acme — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Joseph Rowe <joseph.rowe@acme.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood + Acme — recap & next steps

Hi Joseph / Sara,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the candid rundown of Acme's priorities. Quick recap from our discovery so weu2019re all aligned and to propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum.

Key pain points you called out:
- High per-token inference cost on current provider during peak batch processing.
- Spiky latency impacting real-time features for customer support workflows.
- Lack of reliable audit logs/KMS integration for regulated data.

Goals we heard:
1) Reduce inference unit cost by ~30% on typical batch workloads.
2) Achieve p95 latency < 350ms for live chat use case.
3) Demonstrate SOC2/HSM key management workflow for POC data.

Proposed MAP (milestones & dates) — please confirm if these look right: 
1) Week 1 (by 2027-03-05) — Technical kickoff: review sample workloads, access to a masked dataset, and schedule SE deep-dive.
2) Week 2 (by 2027-03-12) — POC run: Redwood hosts a dedicated POC cluster; run representative batch and live chat traces.
3) Week 4 (by 2027-03-26) — Performance & cost report: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and optimization recommendations.
4) Week 6 (by 2027-04-09) — Executive review & procurement decision: SOW and pricing for Dedicated or Private deployment.

Stakeholders (as discussed):
- Acme: Joseph Rowe (Product), Sara Lin (Infrastructure/Security), Procurement TBD
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineering), Vivek Kulkarni (Enterprise Sales)

Open items / asks for Acme:
- Provide a masked sample of peak-day request traces (s3 or shared Drive link) by 2027-03-03.
- Confirm procurement lead and target decision date for April.
- Fill out the standard security questionnaire (I attached the most recent SOC2 evidence summary).

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Next steps (my ask):
- Can you confirm the milestones above and the internal stakeholders by EOD Monday (2027-02-28)?
- I'll schedule the technical kickoff for the week of 3/1 once I have availability from Aditya & your SE.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Redwood + Acme — recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the summary, this looks helpful. A few quick clarifications: 

1) For the masked sample traces — we can provide a daily export with PII redacted. Is CSV + gz okay? We can upload to the shared Drive link you listed.
2) Procurement: Iu2019m the primary product sponsor, but procurement lead is Linda Gomez (linda.gomez@acme.com). She'll be involved starting the SOW stage (we'll loop her in next week).
3) Security questionnaire — Sara will take point; she may have follow-ups about KMS/HSM specifics.

The timeline looks possible; the only constraint is an internal architecture review on 3/15 that could shift the exec review to the following week if issues pop up. We can tentatively aim for 4/9 but keep the 1-week flex window.

Iu2019m good for a technical kickoff the week of 3/1 — Iu2019m available Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks,
Joseph

Thanks Joseph — great notes. Confirming items below and updating MAP dates with a 1-week flex window for the exec review. Also attached a draft SOW we can use once procurement is engaged.

Updates / confirmations:
- Masked traces: CSV + gz is fine; weu2019ll have Aditya pull in the data pipeline details at kickoff.
- Procurement: please loop Linda Gomez when youu2019re ready; weu2019ll prepare the SOW and pricing options (Dedicated vs Private) for the exec review.
- Security: Sara — happy to set up a 30-min call with our Security lead to go over KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.

Revised MAP (milestones & owners):
1) Technical kickoff — target 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-04 (Owner: Aditya / Acme SE)
2) POC execution — 2027-03-08 to 2027-03-15 (Owner: Redwood SE / Acme eng)
3) Performance & cost report — deliver by 2027-03-22 (Owner: Redwood AM/SE)
4) Executive review & procurement decision — target 2027-04-09 (flex to 2027-04-16) (Owner: Acme Product / Redwood Sales)

Attachments: SOW_ACME_draft.docx (draft SOW)

I'll send a Doodle for kickoff times based on the Tue/Thu morning availability you mentioned. If Tue 3/2 10am PT works, we can lock that in.

Marissa
